doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: The Fender Rhodes suitcase piano
summary: Both recall the suitcase Rhodes, its better sound and the hassle of moving it, including Zawinul and Cannonball.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yes, this is new and improved, Lonnie.
You know I used to have the Fender Rhodes suitcase.
That’s the one. That’s the real one.
That was the one, man. I can’t say I miss moving it though.
Oh people don’t know, that was a trip. But that one had the better sound.

Yes. I won’t forget seeing Cannonball once at some kind of museum or something they were playing in. And in they walk and Joe Zawinul and one other guy on the other end, they’re moving their own Fender Rhodes, and I always remembered that.
Monk, that’s deep, I know. Mm, mm, mm.
